notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 2000, from volumes 47, 48 and 49 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (47minutesofsanfran2000san, January - April; 48minutesofsanfran2000san, May - August; 49minutesofsanfran2000san, September - December). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 1998: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and the motion or resolution number. This batch was read by an external reader (Meta Muse, working from the Internet Archive's one-file djvu text, which has no page breaks) from a written spec, and converted here: every entry's page was then located mechanically in the hOCR page split by its case number, its meeting date and its verbatim quote (976 of 1,001 quotes matched a page of the right meeting exactly; the rest by case number and meeting date, and nine by hand from the case number's OCR). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission (or, reported in the minutes, the Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals) decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; landmark actions; and a dated past fact the calendar prints. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion and an item under 'Items to be continued' are not decisions. Rows read before 15 April 1999 were written to an earlier version of the spec that dropped lettered lots and kept one lot of several; those lots are recovered here from address_as_written, and where the quote was the bare action word the request clause is prefixed from the cited page with ' ... '. A duplicated 63-67 Glover Street occupancy (7 and 14 January 1999) is kept once. The minutes name applicants, owners, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field, and commissioner names the reader put in two notes are removed.

coverage.remaining: Every meeting of volumes 47-49 was read: 45 meeting days, 6 January to 14 December 2000 (16 in volume 47, 16 in 48, 13 in 49), including the special joint meetings with the Redevelopment Agency Commission of 13 January, 8 February and 23 March. Volume 49 ends with the 14 December meeting (pages n362-n412), which the first pass missed and a later pass of the same reader supplied on 4 November 2026; no minutes of 21 December 2000 are bound in it. Next: volume 50 (January - April 2001).
coverage.note: 654 OCR pages with text out of 1276 viewer pages, read by one external reader in one sitting and converted and located in this session.
